title: In SUMMARIZECOLUMNS, ISINSCOPE is TRUE for a group-by column and FALSE for another column of the table

source.quote: ISINSCOPE is useful to detect if a column is currently -- in the rows or columns of a visual (like groupby columns -- of SUMMARIZECOLUMNS)
source.supports: the page shows true for the group-by columns and false for a column that is not grouped

derivation: Product[Color] is the group-by column, so it is in scope in each row. Product[Category] is not grouped. The expressions are never BLANK, so all three colors are returned, Green included.
